instances.claim: This tells me that the film has exactly one thing to say about the indeterminacy of the Cent's value, and is saying it three times to be sure I heard it.
instances.why: Line 16 already closes the five-transformations list with 'continually redefined by decentralized consensus'; line 17 then states 'indeterminate and continually redefined' with no new level of operation, and line 18 states it a third time as 'an ongoing process of redefinition'. Only 18 adds anything — authorship, that Chang set the process going — so 17 sits between two lines that each already carry its content, sharing the word root 'redefined' with both. Keep 16 and 18; cut 17.
